helpLang: Do you want help in your own language? You can skip this.
hearExample: You can hear it at the start of this word.
meetIntro: This letter makes that sound. Tap it to hear it.
traceIntro: Trace the letter with your finger.
blendModel: Watch and listen. Sound by sound, then slide them together.
blendIntro: Say each sound, then tap its letter. Left to right.
blendSay: Now slide the sounds together and say it out loud.
gateRead: Read it to yourself. Say it.
gatePick: Tap the one that matches the word.
gateRepair: Let's look again, sound by sound.
gateReview: We will practise this one again later.
gateTimeout: That's okay. Let's try another one.
spellIntro: Listen. Then build it with the letters.
spellLetter: Listen. Tap the letter that makes this sound.
trickyIntroA: This is a tricky word. The heart part does not sound the way you expect.
trickyIntroB: This is a word to remember. The marked part does not sound the way you expect.
trickyTap: Tap the part that is different.
readIntro: Read it. Tap any word for its sounds.
readHear: Now listen to it read aloud.
listenIntro: Listen to a story. You don't need to read it.
listenQ: Listen to the question. Tap your answer.
checkIntro: Show what you know. Some are made-up words. Just sound them out.
checkPass: You did it! The next part is open.
checkMiss: We'll practise these again. The next part is still open.
miniMiss: Let's practise this sitting again next time.
village: A new piece for your village!
warmIntro: Warm up. What does it say?
soundTap: Tap the letter that makes this sound.
pickNext: What would you like to do next?
selfReport: The app does not hear you. Tap when you have said it.
l1OralFirst: Listen. What sound does it start with?
l1OralBlend: Listen to the sounds. Which word do they make?
l1OralCount: Listen to the word. How many sounds?
l1OralPreview: Here are two letters for next time.
l1OralCheck: Listen to the sounds, and pick the word.
l1Names: Every letter has a name and a sound.
l1NameOrSound: Was that its name, or its sound?
l1Bdpq: These letters look alike. Look closely.
l1MasteryIntro: This is the Level 1 check. Take your time.
l1MasteryPass: You passed Level 1! Level 2 is coming soon.
l1MasteryMiss: Let's practise a little more, then try again.
hello: Hello. I am your reading teacher. I will help you.
homeGoA: Tap the shining sound to go on.
homeGoB: Tap the next lesson to go on.
tapArrow: Tap the arrow to go on.
traceHelp: Follow the faint letter. Go slowly.
alienWord: This is an alien word. Sound it out.
madeUpWord: This is a made-up word. Sound it out.
trickyRegular: This word is not tricky. Sound it out.
selfRead: Read it out loud. Then tap to hear it.
notThatPart: That part sounds normal. Find the different part.
idleTap: Tap the letter. I will wait.
idlePick: Take your time. Tap the one you think.
idleSay: Say it out loud. Then tap the button.
idleTrace: Put your finger on the letter. Trace it.
idleArrow: Tap the arrow when you are ready.
idleHelp: Need help? Tap the speaker to hear me again.
idleWait: I will wait here. Tap when you are ready.
lockedNote: Not open yet. Finish the check first.
nameSoundNote: When we read, we use the sound, not the name.
qNote: The letter q is called cue. With u, it says
tipBedTrick: Make two fists with your thumbs up. Hold them side by side. The left fist is b. The right fist is d. Together they make bed.
tipB: b: the bat comes first, then the ball. The belly of b points right.
tipD: d: the drum comes first, then the stick. The belly of d points left.
tipP: p hangs down. Its loop is at the top, on the right.
tipQ: q hangs down too. It always needs its u.
masteryIntro: This is the check for the whole level. Do your best.
masteryPass: You passed! The next level is open.
masteryMiss: Not yet. Let's practise the parts that were hard, then try again.
teachIntro: Here is a new spelling for a sound. Tap it to hear it.
teachSuffix: This is an ending. Read the base word, then add the ending.
teachExample: Here it is in a word.
teachBlend: These letters keep both sounds. Say them quickly together.
ruleIntro: Here is a rule that helps you read.
attackIntro: A long word. Let's break it apart, step by step.
attackCount: Each vowel sound makes one chunk.
attackPeel: Tap the parts at the start or end that you know.
attackNoPeel: Nothing to take off here. Go on.
attackBlend: Tap each chunk to say it, then put them together.
attackFlex: Is it a real word? If not, try the vowel the other way.
attackCheckIntro: Show how you read a word you have never seen.
notVowel: Not a vowel sound. Try another.
ssPrime: Before you read, think about this.
ssWarm: Read each word out loud. Then tap it.
ssBuild: Build the word. Tap the parts in order.
ssRead: Read one part at a time. Tap a sentence to hear it.
ssFlu: Read it out loud. Tap start when you are ready.
ssThink: Think first. Then tap to see a good answer.
ssMark: How did you do? Tap one.
ssWrite: Write your answer. Then compare it.
ssTalk: Take each role. Say your answer out loud.
mouth_L1.02_A: Put your teeth together. Let the air hiss out.
mouth_L1.02_B: Open your mouth wide, like a big yawn.
mouth_L1.02_C: Tap your tongue behind your top teeth. Tap, tap.
mouth_L1.03_A: Pop your lips. Feel a little puff on your hand.
mouth_L1.03_B: Keep your mouth in a small smile.
mouth_L1.03_C: Touch your nose. Feel it buzz.
mouth_L1.04_A: Close your lips and hum. Feel the buzz.
mouth_L1.04_B: Touch your neck. Feel it buzz when you say d.
mouth_L1.05_A: Say g way back in your throat. Feel the buzz.
mouth_L1.05_B: Make your lips a little round, like a small circle.
mouth_L1.06_A: Say c way back in your mouth. No buzz this time.
mouth_L1.07_A: Say pit, then pet. Your mouth opens a bit more for e.
mouth_L1.07_B: Say cot, then cut. Hear the sound change.
mouth_L1.08_A: Curl your tongue back. It does not touch anything.
mouth_L1.08_B: Hold your hand by your mouth. Blow a little puff of air.
mouth_L1.09_A: Say pat, then bat. Feel the buzz on b.
mouth_L1.09_B: Put your top teeth on your bottom lip. Blow.
mouth_L1.09_C: Put your tongue up. Keep the sound going as long as you can.
mouth_L1.11_A: Say j. Feel a soft, buzzy pop in your mouth.
mouth_L1.11_B: Put your top teeth on your bottom lip. Feel the buzz.
mouth_L1.11_C: Make your lips round. Watch them in a mirror.
mouthLead: Here is how your mouth moves.
